votes.motion: A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Cyndi Sharkey to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Zach Robinson to adopt Resolution 22-30C, (No Truth in Taxation Hearing) a resolution adopting the Sandy City Annual Budget for the Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2022 and ending June 30, 2023; also establishing certain fees and charges in Sandy City for said fiscal year and setting a tax rate on all real and personal property in Sandy City

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Scott Earl to adopt Resolution 22-31C, a resolution adopting the Alta Canyon Recreation District annual budget for the Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2022 and ending June 30, 2023; also establishing certain fees and charges for said fiscal year, and setting a tax rate on all real and personal property in the Alta Canyon Recreation District
